purpose: bind every current stop/activation boundary so autonomous work waits for the live finalist instead of creating unplanned adjacent research, while preserving explicit external-authority blockers

sequence.state: source/factorization/dependency work complete; eleven-node DAG waits at F0

depth.state: source-corrected block boundaries and initialization frozen; waits for accepted sequence parent

width.state: source and CPU oracles complete; seven activation prerequisites wait on sequence/depth/resources/hardware

systems.state: static interfaces complete; all five live activation gates false

interaction.state: estimands qualified; axes unselected; cube absent and unregistered

scaling.state: design frozen; architectures, hardware, budget, fit, and sentinel runs blocked

requires: author or rights-holder exact provenance and intended-use authority
organizational dataset and Llama-2 tokenizer license/scope decisions
qualified proprietary-judge data transmission, retention, deletion, cost, and replacement policy

novelty.requires: two genuinely independent domain-qualified reviews; Speck self-review cannot satisfy independence

currently_allowed_actions: allow the frozen systemd event runner/finalizer to complete the active language cell and successors
after an automatic result commit, run standalone result-acceptance v3 before interpreting it or completing Linear work
after accepted events, synchronize the append-only research ledger and Linear without changing frozen evidence
perform infrequent handle-specific liveness checks when enough time has elapsed; never poll logs, metrics, checkpoints, results, or GPU state during a live cell
run hash/test maintenance after unrelated repository changes
audit a new official source only when it directly changes a named blocker
currently_forbidden_actions: launching, retrying, stopping, or branching the active finalist outside frozen automation
reading live logs, metrics, checkpoint tensors, partial results, or GPU telemetry for an interim look
registering or materializing any sequence DAG descendant before F0 acceptance
implementing depth or width components before their parent activation gates
activating live systems work before all five systems gates pass in order
extracting or executing HELMET data without the named external authorities
performing Speck's own review as an independent N1 review
launching interaction, scaling, paper-scale, or release work before their frozen prerequisites

decision.reason_not_blocked: a specifically identified authorized event-driven training handle remains the progress path; external authority gates do not stop that chain
decision.next_action: enter event-driven wait; on the next sufficiently spaced check, inspect only the specific service/path handle and process a completed commit through acceptance v3
